lifecycle_control.boundary: Node lifecycle and Storage-owned persistent state inside the module; process supervision, WAL/disk, and external recovery tooling outside.
lifecycle_control.reason: Creation (StartNode/RestartNode/NewRawNode), stop (Node.Stop), and recovery (RestartNode from Storage with Config.Applied) semantics already exist; persistent (HardState/log/snapshot) vs volatile (SoftState) state is explicitly defined and not invented.
limitations: Crash recovery beyond Storage contents (disk/WAL) is outside the boundary.
RawNode has no Stop; lifecycle control for the synchronous path is only creation and abandonment, which is inherent to its thread-unsafe design.
lifecycle_control.test_support_reason: Public APIs (StartNode, RestartNode, NewRawNode, Bootstrap, Node.Stop, Config.Applied, MemoryStorage) already compose into creation/stop/recovery tests without new target code; no persistent/volatile split needs to be invented.

RawNode synchronous path: NewRawNode/Bootstrap create a thread-unsafe node with no goroutine; lifecycle is the application's (no Stop on RawNode)
Recovery path: RestartNode -> NewRawNode -> newRaft reads Storage.InitialState (raft.go:442)

message_capture.boundary: Ready processing and rafttest support are inside the boundary; real network send and WAL are outside.
message_capture.gap: No stable control-plane IDs assigned at capture time; no callable list/clear entrypoints; Node-async path auto-continues messages (rafttest/node.go:85-91) instead of parking them.
message_capture.reason: Protocol output points exist (Ready.Messages from r.msgs; rafttest ProcessReady parks messages in env.Messages without auto-continuation), but there is no stable control-plane ID and no callable list/clear entrypoint; the Node-async path (rafttest/node.go ready loop) still auto-sends messages with no capture store.
limitations: Real network send (outside boundary) is not captured; only the protocol output inside the module.
Path coverage: RawNode and AsyncStorageWrites paths park messages; the Node-async goroutine path (rafttest/node.go) does not.
message_capture.suggested_direction: Add low-intrusion capture support in rafttest (ID assignment + list/clear); protocol output path (r.msgs -> Ready) remains unchanged.
message_capture.test_support_reason: env.Messages is a raw exported slice: no stable message IDs, no callable ListPending/ClearPending, and the Node-async path has no capture at all. Per the capture contract this is only a primitive, so additional rafttest support is required.
suggested_changes: Extend rafttest.InteractionEnv with a captured-message store that assigns a stable control-plane ID when ProcessReady parks messages, plus ListPending() and ClearPending() entrypoints.
Add a capture hook in rafttest/node.go's Ready loop (line 85) to route rd.Messages into the same pending store instead of iface.send.
Keep suppression semantics: messages stay parked until explicitly delivered (DeliverMsgs/Stabilize already guarantee no auto-continuation on the RawNode path).
Declare ID scope (per-InteractionEnv pending store) in the interface report.
execution_paths: RawNode synchronous path: readyWithoutAccept exposes r.msgs (rawnode.go:147); ProcessReady moves rd.Messages into env.Messages; no automatic continuation (delivery only via DeliverMsgs/Stabilize)

randomness_control.boundary: Randomized election timeout selection inside the raft core; test harnesses outside.
randomness_control.gap: No shipped Config option or injectable random source; test-only setter is unavailable to library consumers and is overwritten by r.reset on each role transition.
randomness_control.reason: The only protocol randomization (randomized election timeout) draws from a global crypto/rand source (raft.go:91-102, 2049-2051) with no Config option or injectable source. The only setter, raft.SetRandomizedElectionTimeout, lives in raft_test.go (test-only, not shipped) and is overwritten by r.reset on every role transition.
limitations: Same seed determinism is impossible with crypto/rand; even a fixed value is lost on each becomeFollower/becomeCandidate/becomeLeader.
rafttest data-driven tests work only because raft_test.go exports the setter within this repo's test builds.
randomness_control.suggested_direction: Expose the existing random choice via a Config option or public setter; do not replace the election-timeout algorithm.
randomness_control.test_support_reason: The shipped library exposes no Config option, injected source, or hook for the randomized election timeout; the sole setter is a test-only symbol and is clobbered on state transitions, so external test code cannot produce repeatable random choices.
suggested_changes: Add a Config option (e.g., RandomizedElectionTimeout override or a small rand-source hook) consulted in resetRandomizedElectionTimeout (raft.go:2049).
Alternatively promote a public RawNode setter that suppresses re-randomization when set (guard in r.reset).
Wire the option through rafttest raftConfigStub/AddNodes so data-driven tests no longer depend on the test-file export.
